column1: # CrowdStrike — Revenue, Deferred Revenue, RPO & Customer Retention
# Source: SEC EDGAR — XBRL companyfacts (10-K, as reported) + cited 10-K text. USD unless noted.
Revenue recognized from beginning deferred balance
# Dollar-based net retention rate: 115% as of January 31, 2026.
# Revenue mix: subscription ~95% of total revenue; professional services ~5% (FY2026 & FY2025).
# Customer contracts: subscription terms of one to three years, generally billed annually in advance.
# Remaining performance obligations (RPO) of ~$8.8 billion as of April 30, 2026 (FY2027 Q1 10-Q).
# Net revenue retention / customer concentration: no single customer represented a significant concentration of total revenue.
